## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION RED — KB-B1.** docs/rebuild/texas_statutory_retention_on_final_draw_1f5a3780.json, section "Final retainage on a Texas carrier-funded final draw", last sentence: "For every other final draw the Texas retention plays no part in the final retainage." Source fall-through tier (rule and ladder): "for every other final draw the final retainage is the tier's retainage percentage of the remainder" / `otherwise: the tier's retainage percentage of the remainder`. The factor document states what the tier is not, never the method it applies, so the ladder is not carried in full in its own document (the reader can recover the method only from the computation document). Untriggered in this task (task 0 takes tier 1); recorded per whole-domain rule. First revision; no earlier revision.
